integrity: Theorem proved by explicit normal form, generation cases, and a disjoint necessary-nonunit-type lower bound; independent finite full-map enumerator included. Historical-priority risk acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Exact generator ranks only for centralizers with one singleton block and any positive number of doubleton blocks; published historical-priority comparisons do not exclude an uninspected equivalent specialization in earlier centralizer literature.
title: Exact generator rank of mixed singleton–doubleton regular centralizers
